question: Can a fixed 16-channel, 3x3 shared-neural-rule NCA acquire useful behavior from periodic-success vs irregular-failure sensory structure under matched controls and compute?

candidate_architecture.kind: development-only DG-1A candidate; not established native DG-1 integration

required_controls: outcome-independent sham paired within each seed
signal energy/amplitude matched negative control (not yet implemented)
task-derived controls without hidden outcome leakage
matched conventional recurrent or message-passing baseline
no-damage and frozen-development control when regeneration is claimed
required_measurements: pre/post damage function and recovery curve if damage is introduced
note: Proposal for prospective freeze only; a preliminary self-contained DEV gradient test is not a scientific result. No primary/cohort data have been consumed.
